notes.title: Changes to 22.09
notes.content:
With version 22.09 there are some major changes, which we briefly summarize here. We hope to inform you briefly about the changes. If you have any questions, please contact us in Discord!


Shipper types

With patch 22.09 there will be another company type called "Out of competition". In this mode companies have more freedom in our system.
+ In case of an accident, a save can be used to reset the freight damage
+ A separate system statistics for this mode

We will also extend these freedoms in perspective.

Orders that are driven in this company mode and would still be valid according to the rules of the light realism mode will still be included in the user statistics. 
However, this statistic is temporarily deactivated in this mode and cannot be viewed. After switching to the light realism mode, the user statistics will be available again.

Thus, every user has the possibility to decide freely about his desired play style and fairness is maintained towards all companies in the system.


"Synced Cruise Control"

Furthermore, the new patch introduces a new convoy assistant to SpedV.

To use this, a driver must always select the driver directly in front of him in the Drive tab. There is a new button for this. In the game, the assistant can be switched on and off using the key combination {SCROLLOCK}-{C}. This will then control your own cruise control speed depending on the distance and speed of the driver ahead. The target distance can be adjusted in the professional settings.

It should be noted here that this mode does not free you from steering and also from the required attention! In addition, the driver in front should make sure not to deactivate the cruise control if possible (i.e. also brake with it). Due to the speed restriction by SCS, the function only works correctly from about 40 km/h upwards.

In addition, it is now possible to have the cruise control speed automatically throttled if it is higher than the speed limit. This function must be activated manually after each start by clicking on the speed limit display.


Light functions

Been kicked again in TruckersMP because the light was off? This can't happen to you from now on, as SpedV automatically turns on the lights at night. In addition, after an abrupt stop, the hazard warning lights will be switched on automatically. Both functions can be deactivated in the settings.


Parking function

Trucks can now be "parked" in the own truck list and in the branch system. This causes them to not be used for tasks. This makes it possible to use multiple trucks of the same type and better filter which one should be used in the next task. In addition, the fleet management can exclude individual trucks from new taks and thus e.g. mark them for maintenance.


Minor changes

In order to ban less users for minor rule violations, there is now the possibility to warn them only. A warned user must confirm the warning after login. Even expired bans must be confirmed. Hereby we hope to increase the understanding of our rules.

Telegram notifications can now be filtered by type, this should reduce potential spam in larger companies.

When adding Kontor orders via the {SCROLLOCK}-{K} function, it will now automatically save and load if a quicksave was used on the last import.

Lastly, we have completely reworked our updater, biggest change here is the automatic installation of dependencies like the .NET Desktop Runtime.

notes.title: Major overhaul of the truck, branch and maintenance system
notes.content:
We have been working on our new branch system for several months now. Some things have already been teased on Discord or during our Dev-Stream in January, but a summary of the changes and necessary actions is still missing, which is now available here. If you have any questions after this, feel free to contact us via our Discord!


Branches
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33818847/ff16781b7d25b8236b4c12940d21a4f7ebe24fe9.png
The biggest change concerns the branches. These have now been merged with the one from Kontor, so there is no longer any coexistence between different locations here. However, since this change is not really automatically convertible, the branches will also have to be purchased again in the new update. During the update day, we will completely reverse the costs for the previous branches, so you will not incur any loss here.

The new branches have expandable parking spaces for trucks and Kontor trailers, as well as maintenance spaces. There is also storage space for spare parts, more about this under "Maintenance".

The truck parking spaces basically work the same way as before: A truck has a parent branch where it is registered. The only change here is that the branch must match the truck, so an ATS truck can no longer be parked in an ETS branch.

The trailer parking spaces play into the Kontor. This is caused by a new (small) parking fee, that will be waived for Kontor trailers that are not parked in a purchased parking space. However, these are only charged as soon as a trailer is parked on this position for at least 24 real-time hours. Kontor trailers should therefore be transferred to their own branches with enough parking spaces after the update.

Two other small changes: In one city can now exist several branches (in different companies). Also, there is now money back when a branch is sold or downsized.


Truck
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33818847/b514a5ce75f4b5ead5e04b6559d19aebe3bb4bc7.png
There are also some changes regarding trucks. Firstly, the design has been completely changed as well and now presents itself a bit more modern.

Functionally, there are the following changes:

 Trucks can now remain unassigned in addition to being assigned to a driver. These are then freely available and can be used by any user of the company.
 Trucks, however, now have a location. This means that they can basically only be used if the task starts in the city where the truck is located. (There are exceptions to this, however, so a subsequent task can also be started in another city within a 1,000 km radius, as long as the truck actually travels the distance to that city.)
 This location can also be changed via the truck management and (depending on the rights assignment) by the "owner" of the truck, but this costs time and money.
 Trucks used in a paused job cannot be used in another job.
 A driver can now be assigned more than one truck per type.
 Damaged trucks no longer yield value when sold.
If the requirements for using a company truck are not met, a rental truck is automatically used (with rights available for this), so that orders can still be started.

The already existing trucks can only be used once new branches have been purchased. The trucks are automatically distributed to these when they are purchased.


Maintenance
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33818847/55838254db8b72db70ffdb72f171cca73d309dda.png
The maintenance system for trucks has been completely reworked. Also, there is now a maintenance system for trailers. In addition to newly added random damage types, the display of required maintenance has also been revised. 

From now on, maintenance can be performed internally and externally. The former requires maintenance locations, spare parts and correct positioning of the truck/trailer, while the latter costs more time and money.

Spare parts can be purchased at some locations on the map and then have to be transferred to the branch via Kontor order. For this, however, the order can be tendered to other carriers for shipment, so there is no "Kontor constraint" either.

Maintenance jobs can also be planned in advance and get started automatically as soon as all requirements are met. For this purpose, there is a list of planned maintenance with their status (or the information, which prerequisite is not fulfilled) as well as the option to cancel them. Maintenance jobs are only booked as soon as they get started, not directly during planning.


Conclusion
Of course, the changes are very far-reaching. However, with this we hope to depict more realism and thus increase the challenges a bit. However, it is also not necessary to use everything! For example, if someone does not drive consistently, rental trucks can still be used, also the handling of spare parts can be bypassed by using the external maintenance.

Even though the system has been tested for over a month, we will of course accompany the introduction phase of the new functions and look forward to your feedback in order to find and fix problems. This, just like all questions, are welcome in our Discord!

The update is planned for the night from 15.3. to 16.3. There may be some minor downtime, which we will announce separately.

All that remains is to wish you a lot of fun and a safe journey!

notes.title: OMSI for SpedV!
notes.content:
We have compiled and answered some questions for you, so that you are up to date.

If nothing interferes, the update should be released on 9/30.

OMSI? Wasn't SpedV for ETS?

Yes, SpedV is usable for ETS and ATS and will remain so. We now additionally offer the option to record tours in OMSI as well and receive virtual money for it, so users have a wider choice of games that benefit their company.


Is the whole thing to be seen as competition to BCS?

Not in our conception, no. While in ETS/ATS or the BCS in OMSI we have a complete administration with truck or bus management, our OMSI integration is currently limited to recording the trips. Currently, not much more is planned there either.


Why are only single maps compatible?

In order for trip recording to work, SpedV needs to know about them. For this, the maps have to be imported by our admin team. In this process, the schedule (the so-called tours) as well as information about destinations, stops as well as their distance to each other and routes (the so-called trips) are read from the yard file and the map. SpedV then needs these to be able to record the tours. You can read which maps are imported hereand wish for more via our Discord as always.


Why are not all buses compatible?

To read data from the game, OMSI relies on bus- or mostly printer-specific variables. Therefore the printers have to be made compatible manually, which is a programming effort. Since some printers also don't use the normal line/circulation system, it is difficult to impossible to make these buses compatible.


Why does BCS support all buses/printers, but SpedV does not?

To record tours in OMSI certain tradeoffs are necessary due to the nature of the plugin interface. Because the BCS additionally takes access to the savegame, starts OMSI itself and uses partly undocumented functions, it can do more in OMSI itself. 
We decided to use only the pure API as a basis for our implementation. This way we can't influence the weather for example, but in contrast to the BBS we can record streetcar tours for example. Furthermore we don't need to use external software to record the trip, only the telemetry has to be installed once (like with ETS/ATS).


Can I drive a tour in BBS and SpedV at the same time?

Yes.


What requirements do I need to successfully record a tour?

- Telemetry for OMSI installed
- compatible bus and compatible map at compatible time
- no timetable manipulations done on the map
- Timetable activated in OMSI
- Line and course entered correctly
- During the journey the correct station is switched to


Why does the message come up that not enough distance was covered and therefore the stop could not be recorded?

In order to prevent simply shifting on and not driving, we read the KM reading of the buses. This is then compared to the imported distances between stops. If not at least 80% of the distance between the stops has been covered, the stop operation is not registered and this stop is not compensated.
If you notice that this always does not work for some stops, please report to support.


How is the value of the tour calculated?

Partly based on the distance traveled, partly based on the stops. Each stop, depending on the delay, is valued at 100 - 300 €, each KM at 1560 € (corresponding to 78 €/km in ETS scale).
Furthermore, there are bonuses for trips that start within 30 minutes of real time️ as well as bonuses if several trips of the same round trip are completed in succession️. Country-specific taxes are then deducted from the calculated value️.


Do OMSI trips count towards the forwarding destination?

Yes️, for KM forwarding destinations with 20 times the distance to reflect the different scaling.

notes.title: New damage and maintenance model
notes.content:
Howdy!

Today I would like to give you a little preview of the next version, which will be released on Wednesday.

With this version (20.2) a new damage and maintenance system will be introduced in SpedV for the trucks bought by the forwarding agency. This happens in preparation for the introduction of a "used car market" for trucks.

There are fixed maintenance intervals: (EDITED)
- brake pads (every 150k KM)
- Brake discs (every 300k KM, are automatically replaced together with the brake pads if less than 150k KM remain)
- Tyre change (every 200k KM)
- Engine maintenance (every 90k KM)

In addition, there will be (random) damage to the truck that has occurred in certain KM areas since the last occurrence:
- Wishbone failure
- Stabilizing agent defect
- Oscilation damper defect
- Engine failure
- Gearbox damage
- Stone Chip (this can always happen)

The repair of damage and the performance of maintenance (and thus also Main Check and Safety Check) will require time during which the truck cannot be used. Drivers who want to use the truck during the execution of the maintenance automatically rent a rental truck from the company (at the usual conditions). This happens even if driving with rental trucks is not allowed in the permissions!
The same happens if a maintenance/repair is not carried out (before the expiry of the period/the KM).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33818847/9d1d62bb50f11669c467b7e7d9afe90345849654.png

For the management of maintenance and repairs, the update provides a new list in the tab Spedition under "Branches" with a clear overview of all tasks to be completed. Here the fleet manager of the forwarding agency can then have them carried out.

Three notes on the new system:
- For trucks with currently more than 600k KM or 1m KM, the system automatically throws one or more damages directly after the first order due to the way the damage is calculated. This cannot be avoided. 
- Engine and transmission damages usually lead to an economic total loss of the truck concerned. Currently, the damages are not yet included in the sales price of the truck, but this will change with the introduction of the used car market (probably in April).
- In return for the repair and maintenance costs now introduced here, the flat rate for "vehicle and maintenance" has been greatly reduced.

We hope that you will have a lot of fun with the new system, even though it will of course add a little more effort to the management of the shipping company. As always, we ask you for feedback after the implementation, so that we can possibly tighten some screws again.

Always a good trip and good luck!
Nico

(Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator)
